properties.name: awe.application.json-only
properties.description: Serve JSON only. AWE removes every XML-advertising HTTP message converter from the served list, so its wire format does not depend on whether an XML provider (such as {@code jackson-dataformat-xml}) reaches the classpath transitively. With it enabled an explicit {@code Accept: application/xml} answers {@code 406 Not Acceptable}. Set it to {@code false} to keep the XML converters; any other value leaves JSON-only active.

properties.name: spring.datasource.hikari.minimum-idle
properties.description: Minimum number of idle connections kept in the pool of every datasource AWE creates from its database connections (multidatabase). It does not apply to JNDI datasources.

properties.name: spring.datasource.hikari.maximum-pool-size
properties.description: Maximum number of connections in the pool of every datasource AWE creates from its database connections (multidatabase). It does not apply to JNDI datasources.

properties.name: spring.datasource.hikari.connection-time-out
properties.description: Maximum time, in milliseconds, to wait for a connection from the pool of every datasource AWE creates from its database connections (multidatabase). It does not apply to JNDI datasources.

properties.name: spring.datasource.hikari.connection-test-query
properties.description: Query used to check that a connection is alive before it is handed out, for every datasource AWE creates from its database connections (multidatabase). When it is not set, the JDBC driver validation is used. It does not apply to JNDI datasources.

properties.name: spring.datasource.hikari.data-source-map
properties.description: Internal runtime state: datasources created from the AWE database connections, indexed by alias. It is exposed by the binder but is not a setting; do not configure it.

properties.name: spring.datasource.hikari.data-sources
properties.description: Internal runtime state: datasources built from the AWE database connections each time they are loaded. It is exposed by the binder but is not a setting; do not configure it.

properties.name: spring.datasource.hikari.properties
properties.description: Internal runtime state: datasource properties of the connection being built. It is exposed by the binder but is not a setting; configure spring.datasource.* instead.
